build_preemption_decider_process: build a PreemptionDeciderProcess to decide when to preempt GPU-worker stragglers during VER+DD-PPO training
compute_optimal_rollout_time: compute the optimal rollout time by calling _compute_time with step averages and learner time
update_preemption_decision: update the preemption decision by calling update with the number of next steps to collect
start_and_end_rollout: start a rollout with start_rollout and end it with end_rollout passing the next steps count
create_preemption_decider_worker: create a PreemptionDeciderWorker to manage rollout lifecycle via queue-based communication with the decider process
